description: Query Prometheus, explain firing alerts, and discover series from your AI agent.
long_description: prom-mcp is a Prometheus MCP server (Model Context Protocol) that gives AI agents production-grade eyes on your metrics. Run PromQL instant and range queries, explain firing alerts joined with the rule expressions and annotations that fired them, list real label values, and check which series actually exist before querying, so agents investigate instead of guessing. Single static Go binary, no dependencies, talks only to your own Prometheus over stdio.
name: prom-mcp

tools.description: Instant PromQL query, rendered as compact labelled series and values.
tools.name: prom_query

tools.description: Range query over the last N minutes; per-series points with first, last, min, max.
tools.name: prom_query_range

tools.description: Active alerts joined with alerting-rule expressions, rule group, for duration, and annotations.
tools.name: prom_alerts_explain

tools.description: Lists real values of a label (optionally scoped), so the agent learns actual job/instance names.
tools.name: prom_label_values

tools.description: Checks which series exist for a label matcher, so the agent stops hallucinating metric names.
tools.name: prom_series_discover

prom_timeout.description: Timeout for Prometheus requests, e.g. 15s or 30s.
prom_timeout.title: Request timeout

prom_token.description: Bearer token for an auth-protected Prometheus. Leave empty if your Prometheus needs no auth.
prom_token.title: Prometheus bearer token

prom_url.description: Base URL of your Prometheus server.
prom_url.title: Prometheus URL
